To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
knowledge management mediates the relationship between organizational structure, strategy, organizational culture, and organizational effectiveness.
organizational culture, structure and strategy influence knowledge management, which in turn affects organizational effectiveness.

knowledge management fully mediate the impact of organizational cultural on organizational effectiveness, partially mediate the impact on the relationship between organizational structure, strategy and effectiveness.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role that knowledge management plays as a system of knowledge management practices in the relationship between internal organizational resources (culture, structure, strategy) and organizational effectiveness.
the relationship of knowledge management to organizational effectiveness.
knowledge management as a mediating mechanism in the linkage between organizational culture, strategy, structure, and organizational effectiveness.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
knowledge management practices are the mediating factors between organizational culture, strategy and structure and organizational effectiveness.
knowledge management is a system-wide mechanism for connecting organizational culture, structure and strategy with organizational effectiveness.
knowledge management is a key mechanism that can link the internal resources of an organization with its competitive advantage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the results of this study support the notion that knowledge management is a system-wide mechanism for managing the relationship between organizational resources and competitive advantage and, thus, it can be used to enhance organizational performance and effectiveness.
knowledge management practices play an important role in linking organizational culture, structure and strategy to organizational effectiveness.

the findings of this study provide empirical evidence for the mediating role of KM in the relationship between the organizational culture, structure and strategy and organizational effectiveness, and that the mediating role is more pronounced for the organizational culture.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the knowledge management practices should be considered as a system, and not as a set of independent practices.
organizations should not focus on a single management practice, but rather, should consider the interplay of various management practices in achieving competitive advantage.
the knowledge management process can be viewed as a system that connects organizational resources, such as culture, structure, and strategy, and the organizational effectiveness.
